caption:
# Visual Studio Code Interface Description

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left, "Welcome - Clinical_study - Visual Studio Code" in the center, and window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close) on the right.
- **System Information Bar**: Shows "Oct 22 21:48" and a notification bell icon in the center.
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is visible on the far left of the title bar.

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help.
- **Active Menu**: The "File" menu is currently open, displaying a dropdown list of options.

## Sidebar (Left Panel)

- **Explorer Section**:
  - **Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top.
  - **Folder Structure**:
    - "CLINICAL_STUDY" (expanded, with a right-pointing arrow indicating it can be collapsed/expanded).
    - "OUTLINE" (collapsed, with a right-pointing arrow).
    - "TIMELINE" (collapsed, with a right-pointing arrow).
- **Icon Toolbar** (vertical stack of icons):
  - **File Explorer Icon**: Document icon.
  - **Search Icon**: Magnifying glass.
  - **Source Control Icon**: Branching lines.
  - **Debug Icon**: Bug with arrow.
  - **Extensions Icon**: Grid of squares.
  - **Terminal Icon**: Command prompt.
  - **Git Icon**: Octocat logo.
  - **Settings Icon**: Gear icon with a notification badge (number 1).
  - **User Icon**: Person silhouette.
  - **Grid Icon**: 3x3 grid (application launcher).

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Tab**:
  - **Tab Title**: "Welcome" with a close button (X) next to it.
  - **Header Text**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font, followed by "Editing evolved" in smaller font.
- **Start Section**:
  - **Title**: "Start".
  - **Options**:
    - "New File..." with a plus icon and a mouse cursor hovering over it.
    - "Open File..." with an open folder icon.
    - "Open Folder..." with a folder icon.
    - "Connect to..." with a connection icon.
- **Recent Section**:
  - **Title**: "Recent".
  - **Message**: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - **Title**: "Walkthroughs".
  - **Option 1**: "Get Started with VS Code" with a star icon and description "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding". This option is highlighted with a blue underline.
  - **Option 2**: "Learn the Fundamentals" with a lightbulb icon.

## Status Bar (Bottom)

- **Left Side**:
  - **Source Control Indicator**: A branch icon with "0" commits.
  - **Debug Indicator**: A bug icon with "0" errors.
  - **Terminal Indicator**: A terminal icon with "0" processes.
- **Right Side**:
  - **Checkbox**: "Show welcome page on startup" with a checked box.
  - **Notification Icon**: A bell icon.

## Pop-up Dialog

- **Title**: "New File...".
- **Input Field**: "Select File Type or Enter File Name..." with a text input box.
- **File Type Options**:
  - "Text File" with "Built-In" label and "Ctrl + N" shortcut.
  - "Jupyter Notebook" with "ipynb Support" label and "Notebook" label.
- **Action Buttons**: "File" and "Gear" icons are visible to the right of the "Text File" option.

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock**: A vertical dock with application icons including:
  - Google Chrome.
  - Thunderbird.
  - Visual Studio Code.
  - VLC Media Player.
  - LibreOffice Writer.
  - LibreOffice Calc.
  - LibreOffice Impress.
  - GIMP.
  - File Manager.
  - Software Center.
  - Help.
  - Trash.
- **Bottom Dock**: A horizontal dock with application icons including:
  - Activities.
  - Settings.
  - User.
  - Grid.
